title: Multiplexed, Direct miRNA Quantification from Cell Lysates without RNA Isolation
protocol: Retrieve mature miRNA sequence(s) of interest from miRBase.
Design RT primer to form a stable stem-loop structure at reverse transcription temperature (dG < -1.5).
Use mFold software to predict conformation and free energy values of the RT primer under qPCR conditions (dG > -0.5).
Ensure the last 6 nucleotides at the 3' end of the RT primer are the reverse complement of the last 6 nucleotides of the miRNA.

Design a pair of qPCR primers where the reverse primer extends beyond one nucleotide from the 6 nucleotides used for reverse transcription priming and anneals to the stem-loop region of the RT primer.
Ensure the forward primer extends such that it is at most head-to-head with the reverse primer (PCR gap = 0 nt).
Include a 5' GC rich sequence in the forward primer for efficient amplification.
Observe wells using a microscope to ensure cells are evenly seeded within and between wells.
Prepare the lysis buffer as specified in Table 1.
Aspirate cell culture media from wells and wash cells gently once with 100 μl of phosphate-buffered saline (PBS).
Remove PBS as completely as possible before lysis.
Add 40 μl of lysis buffer to cells.
Gently triturate the cells, minimizing bubble formation.
Transfer the lysate from the cell culture wells to a 96-well PCR plate or PCR tubes as appropriate.
Centrifuge briefly to collect the lysate to the bottom of the wells/tubes.
Incubate the lysate for 37°C for 30 min, followed by 70°C for 10 min to deactivate the DNase.
Prepare the RT master mix as specified in Table 2.
Aliquot RT master mix into DNase-treated samples.
Vortex samples and centrifuge briefly to collect them at the bottom of the wells/tubes.
Carry out the RT reaction at 42°C for 30 min.
Heat the reaction mixture to 70°C for 5 min to inactivate the RT enzyme.
Dilute cDNA product to 10% vol/vol with nuclease-free water.
Aliquot cDNA products into PCR reaction vessels.
Prepare the qPCR master mix as specified in Table 3.
Perform qPCR with appropriate thermal cycling parameters on a qPCR-enabled thermal cycler.
Analyze qPCR results with software compatible with the data generated.
